For pull-request review, respect `AGENTS.md` and use the repository's
`code-review` Skill when it is relevant. Consult the Python guidelines, testing
strategy, and applicable implementation plan phase. Use available repository or
GitHub context only when it materially improves the review; compare CI evidence
with the current pull-request HEAD. Prioritize correctness, regression risk,
meaningful tests, architecture boundaries, CI, documentation consistency, and
current scope. Avoid duplicate findings and speculative complexity.
